from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialSnapshot(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from a single 2025 Q1 report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company as stated in the document")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock security code if available")
    reporting_date: str | None = Field(description="Report end date, e.g. '2025-03-31'")
    total_assets: float | None = Field(description="Total Assets amount in CNY")
    equity_attributable_to_shareholders: float | None = Field(description="Equity Attributable to Shareholders amount in CNY")
    accounts_payable: float | None = Field(description="Accounts Payable amount in CNY")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_snapshots: list[CompanyFinancialSnapshot]
